title.zh: v2.0.96 手机端：页眉变回标题栏，控件都能按得到
title.en: v2.0.96 On a Phone: The Header Is a Title Bar Again, and Every Control Is Hittable

highlights.zh: **先量，再改。** 新工具 `scripts/measure_phone_surface.mjs` 在真实构建产物上量 iPhone 14 竖/横两屏：可触摸控件数（分「工作区」与「两条栏」）、每个控件的盒子与是否 < 44 px、横向溢出、固定栏占比、最小字号。竖屏基线：**22 个控件，11 个低于 44 px，其中 9 个在页眉**（Search 36×28、设置 30×30、版本 24×20…）。缩放已被 `user-scalable=no` 挡住 ✓，无横向溢出 ✓。
highlights.en: **Measure first, then change.** The new `scripts/measure_phone_surface.mjs` reads the real build at iPhone 14 portrait and landscape: how many controls are touchable (split into working area and the two bars), every control's box and whether it is under 44 px, horizontal overflow, fixed-chrome share, smallest font. Portrait baseline: **22 controls, 11 of them under 44 px, 9 of those in the header** (Search 36×28, Settings 30×30, the version button 24×20 …). Zoom is already b…

highlights.zh: **页眉在手机上变回标题栏**：只留品牌 + 一个 **44×44 的「全部板块」按钮**，打开 App 自己的 sections sheet；原本 9 个桌面控件与页眉自带的抽屉不再渲染。删减是有依据的：逐条比对后 **sheet 是页眉抽屉的超集**（chords/kick/maker/challenge/masterclass/两条时间线/compare/analyzer/search/settings/help/updates 全在里面），语言开关在 Settings、引导在帮助中心、随机曲风在 Explore 自己那里。类型栏的筛选框与骰子也从 36 px 提到 **44 px**。**低于 44 px 的控件从 11 个降到 2 个**，剩下两个是冻结文件里手机传输条的上一/下一小节（32×44），在门禁里**具名豁免**。
highlights.en: **The phone header is a title bar again**: the brand plus one **44×44 "All sections" button** that opens the app's own sheet; the nine desktop controls and the header's own drawer are no longer rendered. The removal is backed by a line-by-line comparison: **the sheet is a superset of that drawer** (chords, kick, maker, challenge, masterclass, both timelines, compare, analyzer, search, settings, help, updates), the language switch lives in Settings, the tour in the Help centr…

highlights.zh: **新门禁**（只在手机目标上跑）：页眉最多 2 个控件；步进网格之外、当前在屏的每个控件都 ≥ 44×44；并把原来「页眉必须有全局设置入口」改成设备相关——手机上从页眉的「全部板块」进 sheet 再进设置，桌面/平板仍走页眉。三条在 iPhone 竖/横两屏跑通（`E2E_PROFILE=mobile` 4/4）。
highlights.en: **New gates**, mobile targets only: at most two controls in the header; every on-screen control outside the step grid at least 44×44; and the old "the header must have a global settings entry point" assertion made device-aware — a phone goes header → All sections → Settings, desktop and tablet still go through the header. All three pass on iPhone portrait and landscape (`E2E_PROFILE=mobile`, 4/4).
